set.body:
image4s main (ee4148c) delegates frames, points/vectors, dimensions, units and conventions to spatial4s, but keeps a compatibility layer in modules/image4s-geometry/shared/src/main/scala/image4s/geometry/{Identity,Coordinates,Dimension}.scala: type aliases (Frame, FrameId, FrameKey, FrameRecord, FrameRegistry, FrameAlignment, SomeFrame, Point, Vec, Dim/D2/D3/Dimension, LengthUnit, CoordinateConvention) plus forwarders that rewrap spatial4s.SpatialError as GeometryError.

Decision (2026-10-18, eco-u2-coordinates): keep the layer for U2; remove it later because two names per type and the GeometryError/SpatialError duplication blur ownership.

Scope when done:
- Callers in image4s (~77 files), reframe4s (~155 files), and ScalaFIM/neuroim4s import spatial4s directly.
- Delete the aliases and forwarders; frame/dimension/coordinate failures surface as spatial4s.SpatialError, while GeometryError keeps only grid/affine/index cases.
- Preserve persisted spellings: keep LengthUnit.serializedName / CoordinateConvention.serializedName behavior (GridDomain fingerprints, NIfTI unit mapping, flashalign records) under a grid-owned serializer, guarded by byte-identical oracle tests before removal.
- Package moves separate from API changes; JVM+JS.

Best done with or after eco-neuroim-providers/eco-neuroim-core, which rewrite the same ScalaFIM callers.
set.title: Delete image4s.geometry spatial4s compatibility aliases and forwarders
